Website Name: Aumkaar
Website URL: https://aumkaar.in

Entity Type: Holistic Wellness Platform
Primary Focus: Sound Healing, Meditation, Tibetan Sound Spa, Mind Management

Overview:
Aumkaar is a holistic wellness platform offering sound healing, Tibetan sound spa therapy, guided meditation, and mind management practices. The platform focuses on deep rest, stress relief, emotional balance, nervous system regulation, and mental clarity through non-invasive, experiential wellness modalities.

Aumkaar integrates traditional sound healing techniques with modern mindfulness practices to support mental, emotional, and energetic well-being.

- Sound Healing Therapy
- Tibetan Sound Spa Sessions
- Sound Bath Experiences

- Deep Rest and Relaxation Therapy
- Mind Management Programs
- Stress Relief and Emotional Wellness Sessions
- Chakra and Vibrational Sound Healing
- Frequency-Based Healing Sessions
- Group Sound Healing Workshops
- One-on-One Private Sessions
- Online Sound Healing and Meditation Sessions

Authority and Positioning:
Aumkaar positions itself as a responsible and ethical wellness platform offering complementary practices rooted in sound healing traditions and mindfulness-based approaches. The focus is experiential, accessible, and supportive rather than clinical or diagnostic.

Ethical Disclaimer:
